description: Records that the bookkeeper approved these exact values for a client whose bills also need an internal reviewer, so only those values can be approved in Xero next. It changes nothing in Xero.

flowIr.description: Passes the bookkeeper-approved bill to the internal reviewer.
flowIr.name: Bookkeeping AP: send to internal review

outputs.description: True when the bill was passed to the internal reviewer
outputs.name: passed

outputs.description: Why it was not passed on, as code: reason
outputs.name: refused

nodes.summary: Checks the values match the review sheet and the client's route, then notes the sheet's check code on the AP bill row.
nodes.title: Record the bookkeeper's approval

params.description: create (a new bill from email) or update (a bill already in Xero)
params.label: Create or update
params.name: action

params.description: The AP bill row this bill belongs to
params.label: AP bill row
params.name: bill_record_id

params.description: The client's approval route, as recorded at Checking
params.label: Approval route
params.name: route

params.description: For create: the exact Xero bill (Type ACCPAY)
params.label: Bill to create
params.name: invoice

params.description: For update: the bill in Xero
params.label: Xero InvoiceID
params.name: invoice_id

params.description: For update: Status, DueDate and LineItems (coding only)
params.label: Changes
params.name: patch

params.description: For update: the bill's UpdatedDateUTC when it was checked
params.label: Last changed in Xero
params.name: expected_updated_utc

params.description: The check code of the review sheet the person was shown
params.label: Check code
params.name: sheet_digest
